name: Warframe
notes: Plays at ~93-95 FPS on the login screen via DXVK-macOS (M4). The game demands an updated build, which only Tools/Launcher.exe (Chromium) can download: its UI is blank under Wine unless Direct3D is disabled for Launcher.exe (HKCU\Software\Wine\AppDefaults\Launcher.exe\DllOverrides d3d11/dxgi/d3d10core = '') so Chromium falls back to software rendering. Run it once with `stirredctl run warframe --via-steam`, accept the EULA, let it update, then play with the direct launch.
